subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 3/4] exportfs: Display and document read_io= and write_io=

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch updates the exportfs utility to display and document read_io= and write_io= options in its verbose output. It also warns when exporting if these options will be ignored due to a lack of netlink support or an incompatible kernel version. The changes include adding new fields to the exports(5) man page, modifying the exportfs.c file to validate I/O modes, and updating the nfslib.h header file to define the NFSD_IO_DEFAULT value.
